evidence: app/app/routes.ts:1-10 — central, flat route config; deleting a feature is one line
app/app/routes/ability.tsx — entire feature lives in one route file
app/app/routes/pokemon.tsx:241-252 — the only inbound /abilities links, plus its loader data at :135-142 in the same file
app/app/root.tsx:22-27 — nav has no ability links, so no shell edits needed
removability.rationale: Features are one route file plus a routes.ts entry; inbound links are co-located. Only a few orphan CSS rules (e.g. .plain-list, app/app/app.css:387) would linger.

evidence: app/app/components/PokemonCard.tsx:30 — sprite URL built in exactly one place, covering every card list
app/app/routes/move.tsx:23-30, app/app/routes/type.tsx:25-32, app/app/routes/ability.tsx:22-34 — same dedup-and-sort loop written three times
app/app/lib/api.server.ts:63 — dead spriteUrl() duplicates the sprite URL pattern that PokemonCard.tsx:30 actually uses
changeability.rationale: Most fixes (sprites, formatting, data source) land in one obvious place, but a couple of small duplications (species dedup loop, short_effect extraction) mean fixing logic N times, and dead code can mislead.

evidence: app/app/components/PokemonCard.tsx:19-23 — CardSpecies is a narrow 3-field interface
app/app/components/MoveTable.tsx:3-13 — MoveRow interface decouples the table from the loader
app/app/lib/api.server.ts:1-3 — server-only data layer, cleanly separated from client components
app/app/routes/move.tsx:40, ability.tsx:40, type.tsx:52, types.tsx:8, pokemon.tsx:203 — loaderData: any erases the loader→component seam
app/app/routes/move.tsx:35 — spriteBase threaded through every loader instead of derived once
coupling.rationale: Narrow props and a server-only data module keep things loosely coupled, but the widespread loaderData: any makes loader-shape changes unchecked by the typechecker, and mediaBase plumbing repeats per route.

evidence: app/app/components/PokemonCard.tsx:46-69 — PokemonCardList stretches across move/ability/type lists via showTypes/extras
app/app/components/MoveTable.tsx:20-39 — data-driven columns and compareValues handle sorting variation without flag explosion
app/app/components/Section.tsx:1-19 — one uniform region-section abstraction used by every page
app/app/routes/home.tsx:148-156 — home re-implements the card grid instead of reusing PokemonCardList
app/app/routes/ability.tsx:36,48-49 — hiddenBySpecies serialized as object then re-Mapped; stringly 'extra' strings
abstraction_design.rationale: The components cover the app's real variation well, and an Items section would reuse most of the stack; deductions for the home-page list bypass and the awkward extras plumbing rather than flag-parameter creep.

findings.issue: Route components take loaderData: any (also ability.tsx:40, type.tsx:52, types.tsx:8, pokemon.tsx:203), so changing a loader's return shape breaks silently; hand-rolled loader args (pokemon.tsx:31) skip the framework's generated Route.LoaderArgs/ComponentProps types even though react-router typegen is wired up in package.json.
findings.suggestion: Use the generated ./+types/<route> Route.LoaderArgs and Route.ComponentProps so loader→component changes are typechecked (home.tsx:33 already shows the discipline).

findings.issue: The 'map Pokémon refs to unique species, exclude forms, sort by dex' loop is duplicated in three loaders (type.tsx:25, ability.tsx:22), so a change to exclusion or ordering rules must be applied three times.
findings.suggestion: Extract a uniqueSpecies(refs, { hidden }) helper into lib/api.server.ts next to pokemonRefToSpecies and reuse it.

findings.issue: spriteUrl() is dead code that re-encodes the sprite URL pattern actually implemented in PokemonCard.tsx:30 — two places now know the pattern, one of them wrong-looking to a future editor.
findings.suggestion: Delete spriteUrl(), or make PokemonCard consume precomputed sprite URLs from loaders so the pattern lives in one place.

findings.issue: Home inlines its own card-grid markup instead of using PokemonCardList, so any list-level change (sorting, badges, extra content) needs a second edit here.
findings.suggestion: Render the page slice through PokemonCardList (it already supports showTypes), keeping only pagination/filtering in home.

findings.issue: English short_effect extraction with whitespace collapsing is duplicated verbatim in ability.tsx:29.
findings.suggestion: Move a shortEnglishEffect(record) helper into lib/format.ts next to latestEnglishFlavor.

findings.issue: The not-found markup exists twice (root ErrorBoundary and components/NotFound.tsx) plus a per-route notFound-flag branch in four loaders/components instead of the framework's throw data(..., { status: 404 }) + ErrorBoundary pattern.
findings.suggestion: Throw data(null, { status: 404 }) from loaders and render one shared boundary, keeping a single not-found component.

findings.issue: hiddenBySpecies is serialized as an object keyed by id and reconverted to a Map in the component, an extra encoding layer only this page needs.
findings.suggestion: Return the hidden species ids as a plain array (or put 'Hidden ability' in the card data objects) and drop the Map round-trip.

summary: A cleanly layered React Router v8 framework-mode app: one file per feature, a single server-only data module, and reusable presentational components that make most edits land in one obvious place. The main friction is duplicated loader→component glue — untyped loaderData, a species-dedup loop repeated across three loaders, and a home page that bypasses the shared card list. Data-source and sprite concerns are centralized, so the riskiest future changes stay cheap.
